behavior.arguments: rdi is the base-pointer argument; no other argument is read
behavior.load_order: rdx load (base+0x198) first, then rax load (base+0x190); both address from the same base, no chaining
behavior.output_shape: at ret, rax = *(base+0x190) and rdx = *(base+0x198); no return meaning beyond the two registers' contents is claimed

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, no runtime rebase

naming_relocation.note: exactly one R_X86_64_RELATIVE record in .rela.dyn names this window as addend, at slot 0x5759190 in .data.rel.ro; file value 0, applied only at load time — a data-pointer reference, not a direct call
